title: Evaluation of a Constructed DNF
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $ts$ be a finite list of terms on $n$ Boolean variables, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to those variables. The DNF whose terms are $ts$ evaluates to true at $x$ exactly when at least one term in $ts$ evaluates to true at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $ts$ is a list of terms on $n$ variables
$x$ is a Boolean assignment on $n$ variables
